gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-esteban: Round, friendly, and floating apart. Nasalization sets that mood, and Esteban follows with a serif whose thin parts barely slim down from its stems, so the two feel quite different in temperament.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-faustina: Faustina brings a classic serif with a gentle swelling in every round letter. Nasalization above it draws each stroke at full width with no hairline joins, which is where the pair gets its distinct character.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-halant: Pipe-bent letters meet a stubby, upright serif. Nasalization is best at friendly, tubular display shapes, while Halant, a classic serif, does its finest work with a faint thick-thin rhythm and a towering x-height.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-headland-one: Headland One is a classic serif with room between every letter. Reading it goes smoothly, since mild thick-thin shifts carry the eye along while Nasalization stays plain and unmodulated above.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-hedvig-letter: Friendly, spaced-out display letters over a sturdy, tall-bodied text serif. Hedvig Letters Serif would read steadily across a page, its curves open and its thins only slightly lighter than its thicks.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-marcellus-sc: Marcellus SC is a serif with pulled-back terminals and a lowercase of real stature. Nasalization is best at flat, floating friendliness, while Marcellus SC does its best work through light modulation in the strokes.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-montagu-slab: Montagu Slab reads like lightly engraved brass, with robust downstrokes and slender turns. Nasalization is best at unshaded, friendly display shapes, but Montagu Slab, a classic serif, handles the screen reading with its sizable x-height.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-noto-serif-he: A ballpoint-plain line gives Nasalization its friendly, floating look. Yet Noto Serif Hentaigana, a text serif, brings soft shifts in thickness, and its small letters nearly reach capital height, so a modest size is enough.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-ovo: Friendly one-nib letters, then a text serif. Ovo has shallow ascenders and a tall middle band, so a long passage would feel spacious and steady, with thin strokes about half the weight of the thick.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-domine: Glowing bent-wire letters with real vibrance. Domine, a classic serif, steps in with compact ascenders and a mid-range gap between its boldest and faintest strokes, and that dignified restraint is the pair's best quality.
